usamo-1975-q1.summary: For a real number $t$, let $\lfloor t\rfloor$ denote its greatest integer not exceeding $t$. (a) Prove that for all nonnegative real numbers $x,y$, $$\lfloor5x\rfloor+\lfloor5y\rfloor\ge\lfloor3x+y\rfloor+\lfloor x+3y\rfloor.$$ (b) Deduce that for all positive integers $m,n$, the number $$\frac{(5m)!(5n)!}{m!n!(3m+n)!(m+3n)!}$$ is an integer.
usamo-1975-q1.summaryZh: 对实数 $t$，以 $\lfloor t\rfloor$ 表示不超过 $t$ 的最大整数。(a) 证明：对任意非负实数 $x,y$，均有 $$\lfloor5x\rfloor+\lfloor5y\rfloor\ge\lfloor3x+y\rfloor+\lfloor x+3y\rfloor.$$ (b) 由此证明：对任意正整数 $m,n$，数 $$\frac{(5m)!(5n)!}{m!n!(3m+n)!(m+3n)!}$$ 都是整数。
usamo-1975-q1.answer: The inequality holds; the factorial quotient is a positive integer.
usamo-1975-q1.answerZh: 该取整不等式成立，且所给阶乘商为正整数。

methods.title: Reduce modulo one, then compare every fifth
methods.titleZh: 先模一化简，再按五等分比较
steps: We prove the stronger inequality $$\lfloor5x\rfloor+\lfloor5y\rfloor\ge\lfloor x\rfloor+\lfloor y\rfloor+\lfloor3x+y\rfloor+\lfloor x+3y\rfloor.\tag{1}$$ Write $x=a+u$ and $y=b+v$, where $a,b$ are nonnegative integers and $0\le u,v<1$. The two sides of (1) acquire the same total contribution $5a+5b$, so it is enough to prove the original two-term inequality for $u,v$.

By symmetry assume $u\le v$, and put $i=\lfloor5u\rfloor$, $j=\lfloor5v\rfloor$. Thus $0\le i\le j\le4$, $u<(i+1)/5$, and $v<(j+1)/5$. Consequently $$\lfloor3u+v\rfloor\le\left\lceil\frac{3i+j+4}{5}\right\rceil-1,\qquad \lfloor u+3v\rfloor\le\left\lceil\frac{i+3j+4}{5}\right\rceil-1.$$

For the fifteen possible pairs $0\le i\le j\le4$, the resulting upper bounds for the sum on the right are $$\begin{array}{c|ccccc}i\backslash j&0&1&2&3&4\\\hline0&0&1&2&3&4\\1&&2&3&3&5\\2&&&4&4&5\\3&&&&6&6\\4&&&&&6\end{array}$$ and every displayed entry is at most $i+j=\lfloor5u\rfloor+\lfloor5v\rfloor$. This proves (1), and hence part (a).

For part (b), fix a prime $p$. Legendre's formula gives the exponent of $p$ in the factorial quotient as the sum over $r\ge1$ of $$\left\lfloor\frac{5m}{p^r}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{5n}{p^r}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac m{p^r}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac n{p^r}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac{3m+n}{p^r}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac{m+3n}{p^r}\right\rfloor.$$

Apply (1) with $x=m/p^r$ and $y=n/p^r$. Every summand is nonnegative, so every prime has a nonnegative exponent in the quotient. The quotient is rational with no prime in its denominator; therefore it is an integer.
stepsZh: 我们证明更强的不等式 $$\lfloor5x\rfloor+\lfloor5y\rfloor\ge\lfloor x\rfloor+\lfloor y\rfloor+\lfloor3x+y\rfloor+\lfloor x+3y\rfloor.\tag{1}$$ 写成 $x=a+u,y=b+v$，其中 $a,b$ 为非负整数，$0\le u,v<1$。在 (1) 两边，整数部分带来的总贡献都是 $5a+5b$，所以只需对 $u,v$ 证明题目中的两项不等式。

由对称性可设 $u\le v$，并记 $i=\lfloor5u\rfloor,j=\lfloor5v\rfloor$。于是 $0\le i\le j\le4$，且 $u<(i+1)/5,v<(j+1)/5$。从而 $$\lfloor3u+v\rfloor\le\left\lceil\frac{3i+j+4}{5}\right\rceil-1,\qquad \lfloor u+3v\rfloor\le\left\lceil\frac{i+3j+4}{5}\right\rceil-1.$$

对十五组可能的 $0\le i\le j\le4$，右端两项之和的上述上界依次为 $$\begin{array}{c|ccccc}i\backslash j&0&1&2&3&4\\\hline0&0&1&2&3&4\\1&&2&3&3&5\\2&&&4&4&5\\3&&&&6&6\\4&&&&&6\end{array}$$；每个表项都不超过 $i+j=\lfloor5u\rfloor+\lfloor5v\rfloor$。因此 (1) 成立，(a) 得证。

对 (b)，固定任意素数 $p$。由勒让德公式，所给阶乘商中 $p$ 的指数等于对所有 $r\ge1$ 求和：$$\left\lfloor\frac{5m}{p^r}\right\rfloor+\left\lfloor\frac{5n}{p^r}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac m{p^r}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac n{p^r}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac{3m+n}{p^r}\right\rfloor-\left\lfloor\frac{m+3n}{p^r}\right\rfloor.$$
在 (1) 中取 $x=m/p^r,y=n/p^r$，便知每个求和项均非负。因此任意素数在该阶乘商中的指数都非负；这个有理数的分母不含任何素因子，故它是整数。

usamo-1975-q2.summary: For arbitrary points $A,B,C,D$ in three-dimensional space, prove $$AC^2+BD^2+AD^2+BC^2\ge AB^2+CD^2,$$ and identify the equality case.
usamo-1975-q2.summaryZh: 对三维空间中的任意四点 $A,B,C,D$，证明 $$AC^2+BD^2+AD^2+BC^2\ge AB^2+CD^2,$$ 并确定等号成立条件。
usamo-1975-q2.answer: The inequality always holds. Equality occurs exactly when the midpoints of $AB$ and $CD$ coincide.
usamo-1975-q2.answerZh: 不等式恒成立；等号当且仅当线段 $AB$ 与 $CD$ 的中点重合。

methods.title: Separate the midpoint displacement
steps: Let the position vectors of the four points be $a,b,c,d$, and let $M=(a+b)/2$ and $N=(c+d)/2$ be the midpoints of $AB$ and $CD$.
Write $a=M+u,b=M-u,c=N+v,d=N-v$. Then $AB^2=4|u|^2$ and $CD^2=4|v|^2$.
Expanding the four cross-distances and cancelling mixed terms gives $$AC^2+AD^2+BC^2+BD^2=4|M-N|^2+4|u|^2+4|v|^2.$$ Hence $$AC^2+BD^2+AD^2+BC^2-AB^2-CD^2=4|M-N|^2\ge0.$$
Equality holds precisely when $M=N$, that is, when the two segments have the same midpoint. This includes coincident or degenerate points without requiring a separate case.
stepsZh: 设四点的位置向量分别为 $a,b,c,d$，并令 $M=(a+b)/2,N=(c+d)/2$ 分别为 $AB,CD$ 的中点。
展开四个交叉距离并消去混合项，得到 $$AC^2+AD^2+BC^2+BD^2=4|M-N|^2+4|u|^2+4|v|^2.$$ 因而 $$AC^2+BD^2+AD^2+BC^2-AB^2-CD^2=4|M-N|^2\ge0.$$
等号成立当且仅当 $M=N$，即两条线段的中点重合。即使某些点重合或线段退化，此结论也无需另作讨论。

usamo-1975-q3.summary: Let $P$ be a polynomial of degree $n$ such that $$P(k)=\frac{k}{k+1}\qquad(k=0,1,\ldots,n).$$ Determine $P(n+1)$.
usamo-1975-q3.summaryZh: 设 $P$ 是次数为 $n$ 的多项式，并满足 $$P(k)=\frac{k}{k+1}\qquad(k=0,1,\ldots,n).$$ 求 $P(n+1)$。

methods.title: Create a polynomial with known consecutive roots
methods.titleZh: 构造具有连续已知根的多项式
steps: Define $Q(x)=(x+1)P(x)-x$. Its degree is at most $n+1$, and the given data imply $Q(k)=0$ for every $k=0,1,\ldots,n$.

Therefore $$Q(x)=c\,x(x-1)\cdots(x-n)$$ for some constant $c$. Evaluating at $x=-1$ avoids knowing any coefficient of $P$: $$1=Q(-1)=c(-1)(-2)\cdots(-n-1)=c(-1)^{n+1}(n+1)!.$$ Thus $c=(-1)^{n+1}/(n+1)!$.
Solving gives $$P(n+1)=\frac{n+1+(-1)^{n+1}}{n+2}.$$
stepsZh: 定义 $Q(x)=(x+1)P(x)-x$。它的次数不超过 $n+1$，且由题设知 $Q(k)=0$ 对每个 $k=0,1,\ldots,n$ 都成立。

usamo-1975-q4.summary: Two distinct circles meet at $P$ and $Q$. A line through $P$ meets the first circle again at $A$ and the second again at $B$, with $P$ lying on segment $AB$. Construct the line for which $AP\cdot PB$ is greatest, and justify the construction.
usamo-1975-q4.summaryZh: 两个不同的圆交于 $P,Q$。过 $P$ 的一条直线再次交第一圆于 $A$、第二圆于 $B$，且 $P$ 在线段 $AB$ 上。作出使 $AP\cdot PB$ 最大的直线，并证明该作法正确。
usamo-1975-q4.answer: If the circle centres are $O_1,O_2$, draw from $P$ the internal bisector of the angle between the ray $PO_1$ and the ray opposite to $PO_2$; extend it in both directions. Its second intersections with the circles are the required $A,B$.
usamo-1975-q4.answerZh: 设两圆圆心为 $O_1,O_2$。在 $P$ 点作射线 $PO_1$ 与 $PO_2$ 反向射线所成角的内角平分线，并向两端延长；它与两圆的另一个交点即为所求的 $A,B$。

methods.title: Maximise two projections
methods.titleZh: 最大化两个投影的乘积
steps: Let the centres and radii be $O_1,O_2$ and $R_1,R_2$. Choose a unit vector $u$ from $P$ toward $A$; then $B$ lies on the opposite ray. Put $U=O_1-P$ and $V=P-O_2$. The ray enters the appropriate circle exactly when $u\cdot U>0$ and $u\cdot V>0$.
Substituting $A=P+tu$ in $|A-O_1|=R_1=|P-O_1|$ gives $t=2u\cdot U$, so $AP=2u\cdot U$. Similarly, writing $B=P-su$ gives $PB=2u\cdot V$.

Let $e=U/R_1$ and $f=V/R_2$, and let $\theta$ be the angle between these unit vectors. Measure the signed angle $t$ of $u$ from their internal angle bisector, so $e$ and $f$ have signed angles $-\theta/2$ and $\theta/2$ from that bisector. Then, for every direction $u$, $$AP\cdot PB=4R_1R_2\cos(t+\theta/2)\cos(t-\theta/2)=4R_1R_2\bigl(\cos^2t-\sin^2(\theta/2)\bigr).$$

Because $\cos^2t\le1$, the product is at most $4R_1R_2\cos^2(\theta/2)$. Equality holds for the feasible orientation exactly when $t=0$. Thus $u$ must bisect the angle between the ray $PO_1$ and the ray in the direction $P-O_2$, which is the ray opposite to $PO_2$.

Construction: locate the two centres, reverse the ray $PO_2$ through $P$, bisect the resulting angle with $PO_1$, and extend the bisector as a full line. The second intersections on its two sides are $A$ and $B$, and the preceding equality condition proves maximality.
stepsZh: 设两圆的圆心与半径分别为 $O_1,O_2$ 和 $R_1,R_2$。取从 $P$ 指向 $A$ 的单位向量 $u$，则 $B$ 位于反向射线上。记 $U=O_1-P,V=P-O_2$。直线朝相应方向进入两个圆的条件正是 $u\cdot U>0,u\cdot V>0$。
把 $A=P+tu$ 代入 $|A-O_1|=R_1=|P-O_1|$，可得 $t=2u\cdot U$，即 $AP=2u\cdot U$。同理，写成 $B=P-su$ 可得 $PB=2u\cdot V$。

令 $e=U/R_1,f=V/R_2$，并设这两个单位向量的夹角为 $\theta$。以它们的内角平分线为基准，记 $u$ 的有向角为 $t$；则 $e,f$ 相对该平分线的有向角分别为 $-\theta/2,\theta/2$。因此对任意方向 $u$，都有 $$AP\cdot PB=4R_1R_2\cos(t+\theta/2)\cos(t-\theta/2)=4R_1R_2\bigl(\cos^2t-\sin^2(\theta/2)\bigr).$$
因为 $\cos^2t\le1$，乘积至多为 $4R_1R_2\cos^2(\theta/2)$；对可行的取向，等号恰在 $t=0$ 时成立。因此 $u$ 必须平分射线 $PO_1$ 与方向为 $P-O_2$ 的射线之间的角；后一条射线正是 $PO_2$ 的反向射线。
作法如下：确定两圆圆心，在 $P$ 处作 $PO_2$ 的反向射线，再作它与 $PO_1$ 所成角的内角平分线，并延长为整条直线。直线两侧与两圆的另一个交点即为 $A,B$；上述等号条件同时证明乘积最大。

usamo-1975-q5.summary: A deck has $n$ cards, exactly three of which are aces. After a uniformly random shuffle, cards are turned over from the top until the second ace appears. Prove that the expected number of cards turned over is $(n+1)/2$.
usamo-1975-q5.summaryZh: 一副牌共有 $n$ 张，其中恰有三张 A。充分随机洗牌后，从顶端依次翻牌，直到第二张 A 出现为止。证明所翻牌数的期望为 $(n+1)/2$。

methods.title: Use the four exchangeable gaps
steps: Let the ace positions be $1\le X_1<X_2<X_3\le n$. Every three-element subset of positions is equally likely.
Define the numbers of non-aces in the four gaps by $$G_0=X_1-1,\quad G_1=X_2-X_1-1,\quad G_2=X_3-X_2-1,\quad G_3=n-X_3.$$ These are nonnegative and satisfy $G_0+G_1+G_2+G_3=n-3$.

Each ace-position set corresponds bijectively to one ordered quadruple of nonnegative integers with sum $n-3$. Because the position sets are uniform, these quadruples are uniform; permuting their four coordinates preserves the sample space. Thus the four gaps have the same expectation.
Taking expectations in their sum gives $\mathbb E[G_i]=(n-3)/4$ for every $i$.
The second ace occurs after the first two gaps and two aces, so $X_2=G_0+G_1+2$. Hence $$\mathbb E[X_2]=2\cdot\frac{n-3}{4}+2=\frac{n+1}{2}.$$
stepsZh: 设三张 A 的位置为 $1\le X_1<X_2<X_3\le n$。任意三个位置组成的子集都等可能。
定义四段非 A 牌的张数：$$G_0=X_1-1,\quad G_1=X_2-X_1-1,\quad G_2=X_3-X_2-1,\quad G_3=n-X_3.$$ 它们都是非负整数，且 $G_0+G_1+G_2+G_3=n-3$。
每组三个 A 的位置与一组总和为 $n-3$ 的有序非负整数四元组一一对应。由于位置集合等可能，这些四元组也等可能；交换四个坐标仍保持样本空间不变。因此四个空隙具有相同期望。
对空隙总和取期望，得到每个 $i$ 都有 $\mathbb E[G_i]=(n-3)/4$。
第二张 A 之前包含前两个空隙和两张 A，所以 $X_2=G_0+G_1+2$。因此 $$\mathbb E[X_2]=2\cdot\frac{n-3}{4}+2=\frac{n+1}{2}.$$

methods.title: Pair every shuffle with its reversal
methods.titleZh: 把每种排列与逆序排列配对
steps: If a shuffle has ace positions $X_1<X_2<X_3$, reversing the entire deck produces ace positions $n+1-X_3<n+1-X_2<n+1-X_1$.
Therefore the position of the second ace in the reversed shuffle is exactly $n+1-X_2$.
Reversal is a bijection of the equally likely shuffles. Pairing each shuffle with its reversal, the two second-ace positions always sum to $n+1$.
The average within every pair is $(n+1)/2$, so the expected number of cards turned over is $(n+1)/2$.
stepsZh: 若某一排列中三张 A 的位置为 $X_1<X_2<X_3$，把整副牌完全逆序后，三张 A 的位置变为 $n+1-X_3<n+1-X_2<n+1-X_1$。
所以逆序排列中第二张 A 的位置恰为 $n+1-X_2$。
逆序操作是所有等可能排列上的双射。将每个排列与其逆序排列配对，两者的第二张 A 位置之和恒为 $n+1$。
每一对的平均值都是 $(n+1)/2$，故所翻牌数的期望为 $(n+1)/2$。
